stringOrder: ascending unsigned UTF-8 byte order without locale collation
pathProfile: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; root is the empty string; ~ and / are encoded as ~0 and ~1
duplicatePolicy: Identical findings are retained because multiplicity is evidence; adapters must not deduplicate unless the fixture expectation does.
messagePolicy: Messages are stable English templates with no native-validator text, payload bytes, secrets, timestamps, or environment data.
adapterRequirement: Native validator results are mapped to governed codes and paths before sorting and comparison.
problemDetailsBinding: ProblemDetailsV1 field errors use this exact ordering and governed retryability values.
